en.meta_description: Samsung Washing Machine Won't Complete a Cycle? See verified Samsung causes, safe external checks and when authorised service is required.
en.h1: Samsung Washing Machine Won't Complete a Cycle
en.description: Samsung notes that load sensing, an unbalanced load, low water pressure, excess suds or drainage trouble can extend or interrupt a wash cycle.
en.quick_fix: Record the displayed message and programme stage, redistribute the load, confirm water supply and inspect the visible drain hose (about 5–30 minutes).
en.intro_html:
Samsung notes that load sensing, an unbalanced load, low water pressure, excess suds or drainage trouble can extend or interrupt a wash cycle.

Record the displayed message and programme stage, redistribute the load, confirm water supply and inspect the visible drain hose. Dismantle nothing and make no electrical measurements.

en.when_to_call_technician_html:

en.prevention_html:
Follow installation and load guidance, empty pockets, dose correctly and keep visible hoses and user-accessible filters clean as the manual specifies.

Keep the washer level; internal component faults cannot be prevented through dismantling.

faq_json.question: Can I keep using the washer?
faq_json.answer: Only if it returns to completely normal operation after a safe external correction and no warning symptom is present.

faq_json.question: Should I open an appliance panel?
faq_json.answer: No. Limit checks to parts the manual explicitly identifies as user-accessible.

faq_json.question: Should I order a replacement part?
faq_json.answer: Not from the symptom alone. Internal faults require diagnosis for the exact E-Nr.

faq_json.question: When is Samsung service required?
faq_json.answer: When the issue remains or returns, or when an internal, electrical, leakage or mechanical fault is suspected.
